name: The Question: The Tease
source:
You just finished sitting through a presentation by Eileen and now you need to see your friend Sylvie to ask her the ultimate question, but can you overcome your indecision and shyness to do it? It won’t be easy, because Sylvie is a merciless tease.

[From [url=https://forestmastergames.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]The Official Website[/url]]
translation:
你刚听完艾琳的演讲，现在需要去找朋友希尔维，向她提出那个终极问题。但你能克服自己的犹豫和害羞吗？这并不容易，因为希尔维是个毫不留情的捉弄高手。

[来源：[url=https://forestmastergames.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]官方网站[/url]]
